input: i want to manage docker containers
i want to see docker containers
i want to stop a docker container

arguments.command:
tput cuu 1 && termy_say "Please choose a docker management option" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "
1) 🐳 List Running Containers
2) 🛑 Stop a Container
3) 📜 View Container Logs

Select option 1-3: " && read -r dock_choice && case "$dock_choice" in 1) docker ps && printf "
" && termy_say "Containers listed" > /dev/null 2>&1 ;; 2) termy_say "Please enter the container name or I D" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "Container ID or Name: " && read -r c_name && if [ -n "$c_name" ]; then docker stop "$c_name" && printf "
Stopped container \033[1m%s\033[22m.
" "$c_name" && termy_say "Container stopped successfully" > /dev/null 2>&1; else printf "
⛔ Selection cannot be empty.
" && termy_say "Operation cancelled" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; 3) termy_say "Please enter the container name or I D" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "Container ID or Name: " && read -r c_log && if [ -n "$c_log" ]; then docker logs --tail 20 "$c_log" && printf "
" && termy_say "Logs displayed" > /dev/null 2>&1; else printf "
⛔ Selection cannot be empty.
" && termy_say "Operation cancelled" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *) printf "
⛔ Invalid choice.
" && termy_say "Invalid selection" > /dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac
arguments.explanation: Provides a menu for managing Docker containers, allowing the user to list, stop, or view logs of containers.
